goal_context: Continue toward a complete Bominal-grade Oyatie mockup. This slice targets the remaining sparse Ontology and Intelligence panels after prior slices improved Workflow, Governance, Finance, Comms, Cloud, Identity, Daily execution, and Catalog surfaces.

product_direction_applied.user_directive: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
product_direction_applied.ui_interpretation: Ontology now shows FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads running on Oyatie Cloud; Intelligence now stays human-gated and routes recommendations into Workflow, Mail, Community, and Evidence rather than implying auto-execution.

병목: 공계 승인 단계 (2.1d)

과거 12회 사이클 평균 0.6d. 최유나 매니저에 위임 권한 자동 부여 시 1.4d 단축.

User must review before HomeTax send.
$53 위험: 윤태민

이번 주 49.5h 예상. 백업 가능 인력 2명 추천.

Uses permitted roster data only.

change_summary: Replaced the old three-item ontology list presentation with a full-width typed tenant workload graph showing Tenant, FD-001 Workloads, Oyatie Cloud, Workflow, built-in Comms, Evidence, and Policy nodes.
Added ontology fact cards, substrate-proof rail, role/data-class visibility explanation, node selection, sidepeek inspection, policy/evidence/workflow actions, and local status feedback.

Replaced the old plain advisory suggestion list with a governed AI command console: evaluation score strip, routed recommendation cards, guardrail harness, route grid, dismissal, preview, and local workflow/mail/community/evidence routing.
Changed the studio layout so Workflow, Ontology, and Intelligence are readable command surfaces rather than skinny side rails.
Updated SSR/static rendering paths so the dense consoles are present before hydration, and added fallback JS interaction handlers for the same local-only behavior.

differences: The implementation is Oyatie-native rather than a direct Bominal clone; Bominal Workflow Studio supplies density, command chrome, and graph language only.
The graph and AI panels emphasize FD-001 tenant workload dogfooding on Oyatie Cloud, which is newer product direction beyond the supplied Bominal references.
The full mockup goal remains active; this evidence proves only the Ontology/Intelligence regression slice.
suggestions: Continue requirement-by-requirement final audit across the entire dashboard before claiming complete mockup status.
Consider adding a single global FD-001/Oyatie Cloud narrative banner or first-run walkthrough after all major surfaces reach parity.
visual_verdict.reasoning: Before audit showed Ontology and Intelligence had only three text rows each and zero local controls. Browser smoke now proves dense graph nodes, fact cards, AI cards, guardrail route actions, status changes, and cross-surface routing with no console errors or failed requests.

ssr_smoke.note: Initial empty replies can occur during container compile/restart; final ready response contained the SSR console markup.
